contributions.title: Rate limit mặc định của public API
contributions.body: Rate limit mặc định của public API là 100 request/phút cho mỗi API key.

contributions.title: Chính sách retry của webhook
contributions.body: Webhook retry dùng exponential backoff, tối đa 8 lần trong 24 giờ.

contributions.title: Large refunds need a second approver
contributions.body: Refund over $10,000 requires a second approver from finance.

contributions.title: Idempotency key retention
contributions.body: Idempotency keys are kept for 24 hours, then reused keys create new charges.

contributions.title: Cách lưu số tiền trong hệ thống
contributions.body: Tất cả số tiền được lưu bằng số nguyên theo đơn vị nhỏ nhất (minor units).

contributions.title: Removal of the /v1/charges endpoint
contributions.body: The /v1/charges endpoint will be removed at the end of Q2.

contributions.title: 3-D Secure for EU cards
contributions.body: 3-D Secure is mandatory for every card issued in the EU.

contributions.title: Timeout khi gọi ngân hàng đối tác
contributions.body: Timeout gọi sang ngân hàng đối tác là 30 giây.

contributions.title: Exchange rate used for currency conversion
contributions.body: Currency conversion uses the mid-market rate captured at authorization time.

contributions.title: PCI scope boundaries
contributions.body: PCI scope only covers the tokenization service, not the checkout frontend.

contributions.title: Visa chargeback window
contributions.body: Chargeback window for Visa is 120 days from the transaction date.

contributions.title: Retry of failed payouts
contributions.body: Failed payouts are retried automatically the next business day.

contributions.title: Partition và thời gian lưu bảng events
contributions.body: Bảng events được partition theo ngày, giữ lại 400 ngày.

contributions.title: Nightly ETL completion time
contributions.body: The nightly ETL finishes before 06:00 UTC on 95% of days.

contributions.title: Backup snapshot warehouse sang region khác
contributions.body: Snapshot của warehouse được backup sang region thứ hai mỗi 6 giờ.

contributions.title: PII hashing in the data lake
contributions.body: PII columns are hashed with a per-tenant salt before landing in the lake.

contributions.title: Giới hạn thời gian chạy query
contributions.body: Query nào chạy quá 15 phút sẽ bị tự động kill.

contributions.title: Incremental dbt builds
contributions.body: dbt models are rebuilt incrementally except for the finance marts.

contributions.title: Kafka topic retention
contributions.body: The Kafka cluster keeps 7 days of retention on every topic.

contributions.title: Độ trễ dữ liệu của dashboard doanh thu
contributions.body: Dashboard doanh thu lấy dữ liệu trễ tối đa 2 giờ.

contributions.title: Review for events schema changes
contributions.body: Schema changes to the events table need a data-contract review.

contributions.title: Spark job instance types
contributions.body: Spark jobs run on spot instances with on-demand fallback.

contributions.title: Phiên bản iOS tối thiểu
contributions.body: App iOS hỗ trợ từ iOS 15 trở lên.

contributions.title: Crash-free sessions of the last release
contributions.body: Crash-free sessions were above 99.5% for the last release.

contributions.title: Offline order cache
contributions.body: Offline mode caches the last 50 orders on the device.

contributions.title: Android push notification opt-in rate
contributions.body: Push notification opt-in rate on Android is around 70%.

contributions.title: Kích thước ảnh đại diện khi upload
contributions.body: Ảnh đại diện được nén về tối đa 512x512 trước khi upload.

contributions.title: Fallback when biometric login fails
contributions.body: The app falls back to SMS OTP when biometric login fails three times.

contributions.title: Feature flag refresh interval
contributions.body: Feature flags are fetched on cold start and refreshed every 15 minutes.

contributions.title: UI framework cho màn hình Android mới
contributions.body: Bản Android dùng Jetpack Compose cho toàn bộ màn hình mới.

contributions.title: Where email deep links open
contributions.body: Deep links from email open the in-app browser, not Safari.

contributions.title: Mobile release cadence
contributions.body: Release train ships every two weeks on Tuesday.

contributions.title: Dark mode default
contributions.body: Dark mode follows the system setting by default.

contributions.title: Phiên bản database production
contributions.body: Database chính chạy PostgreSQL 16 với 2 read replica.

contributions.title: Primary and failover regions
contributions.body: Primary region is us-east-1; failover target is us-west-2.

contributions.title: On-call rotation handover
contributions.body: On-call rotation is weekly and hands over on Monday 10:00 local time.

contributions.title: TLS certificate renewal
contributions.body: TLS certificates are renewed automatically 30 days before expiry.

contributions.title: Review thay đổi Terraform
contributions.body: Mọi thay đổi Terraform phải qua review của ít nhất một người khác.

contributions.title: Container image CVE scanning
contributions.body: Container images are scanned for CVEs on every push to main.

contributions.title: Thời gian giữ log production
contributions.body: Log của production được giữ 30 ngày trên hot storage.

contributions.title: Staging environment rebuild schedule
contributions.body: The staging environment is wiped and rebuilt every Sunday night.

contributions.title: SSH access to production hosts
contributions.body: SSH access to production hosts requires a short-lived certificate.

contributions.title: Backup restore tests
contributions.body: Backups are restore-tested once per quarter.

contributions.title: Autoscaling threshold
contributions.body: Autoscaling kicks in at 70% average CPU over 5 minutes.

contributions.title: Chi phí cloud tháng trước
contributions.body: Chi phí cloud tháng trước tăng 12% so với tháng trước nữa.

contributions.title: Thời gian onboarding kỹ sư mới
contributions.body: Quy trình onboarding kỹ sư mới kéo dài 2 tuần.

contributions.title: Changelog requirement for public API changes
contributions.body: Every public API change needs a changelog entry before merge.

contributions.title: Postmortem publication deadline
contributions.body: Incident postmortems are published within 5 business days.

contributions.title: Chu kỳ review tài liệu kiến trúc
contributions.body: Tài liệu kiến trúc được review lại mỗi quý.

contributions.title: Code style enforcement in review
contributions.body: Code style is enforced by CI; reviewers should not comment on formatting.

contributions.title: Summary required for long design docs
contributions.body: Design docs over 10 pages must include a one-page summary.

contributions.title: Weekly focus days
contributions.body: Engineers get two focus days without meetings per week.

contributions.title: Webhook có gửi sự kiện theo đúng thứ tự không?
contributions.body: Consumer của mình có cần tự sắp xếp lại sự kiện theo thời gian không?

contributions.title: Không đảm bảo thứ tự giao sự kiện webhook
contributions.body: Sự kiện được giao ít nhất một lần và không theo thứ tự; consumer nên sắp xếp theo trường created.

contributions.title: Retries can arrive after newer events
contributions.body: Because retries use exponential backoff, a retried event may arrive after a newer event for the same object.

contributions.title: How do I get access to the finance marts?
contributions.body: I need read access for a quarterly report.

contributions.title: Request finance mart access through the access portal
contributions.body: Access to marts is granted per domain through groups; the finance mart owner approves requests in the access portal.

contributions.title: Which Android versions does the app support?
Có runbook failover sang us-west-2 không?
contributions.body: Trước buổi diễn tập quý tới mình muốn đọc trước quy trình.

contributions.title: Runbook failover nằm trong repo infra-runbooks
contributions.body: Runbook failover sang us-west-2 nằm trong repo infra-runbooks, mục dr/failover.md.

contributions.title: The failover runbook is out of date
contributions.body: The runbook still references the old load balancer; the last exercise had to improvise the DNS step.

contributions.title: DNS TTL is lowered to 60 seconds before an exercise
contributions.body: Before each failover exercise the public DNS TTL is lowered to 60 seconds a day in advance.

contributions.title: Who approves exceptions to the focus days rule?
Engineering managers approve focus-day exceptions
contributions.body: Exceptions are approved by the engineer's manager and logged in the team calendar.
